title: fix(service-storage): a refused presigned token answers 401 INVALID_TOKEN on both raw byte routes, never a 500
body:
Fixes #23143
Clause-②: no — a refused token answers its 4xx instead of 5xx; no published schema or export moves.

## What changes

`PUT` and `GET /api/v1/storage/_local/raw/:token` are the local adapter's presigned byte routes. Each now answers every token the adapter will not honour with **`401 INVALID_TOKEN`** and one message, `Invalid or expired token`. Any other throw stays **`500 INTERNAL`**.

- `LocalStorageAdapter.verifyToken` (`local-storage-adapter.ts`) throws one branded `StorageTokenRefusedError` from all five of its refusal branches: bad format, bad signature, unreadable signed payload, wrong verb, expired. All five carry the same message, so the answer never tells a forger which check failed. The predicate `isStorageTokenRefusal` reads an own-property brand, not `instanceof`, because a second copy of the module (an ESM host handing a CJS-built adapter to the routes) must still be recognised. This follows `@objectstack/core`'s `AuthzStoreUnavailableError`. None of the three new symbols is re-exported from the package entry.
- The two handlers' catch blocks (`storage-routes.ts`) now share `sendRawByteRouteFailure`, which classifies by the brand. The old `invalidToken` test searched `err.message` for `expired` or `signature`, which is what went wrong in both directions (below).

## Measured before and after

This is a route-level drive of both handlers through `registerStorageRoutes`. Each case ran over the bare adapter and over the `SwappableStorageService` wrapper that `StorageServicePlugin` actually mounts, which passes the adapter's throw through. Before = `origin/main` `02bec6ca86`; after = this branch. Both compositions gave identical answers.

| case | before (PUT and GET) | after (PUT and GET) |
|---|---|---|
| malformed (no dot, or empty signature) | `500 INTERNAL` "Invalid storage token format" | `401 INVALID_TOKEN` "Invalid or expired token" |
| forged signature | `403 INVALID_TOKEN` "Invalid storage token signature" | same 401 |
| signed but unreadable payload | `500 INTERNAL` "Malformed storage token payload" | same 401 |
| minted for the other verb | `500 INTERNAL` "Storage token op mismatch (expected=…, actual=…)" | same 401 |
| expired | `403 INVALID_TOKEN` "Storage token expired" | same 401 |
| valid token, adapter throws "disk on fire" | `500 INTERNAL` | `500 INTERNAL` |
| valid token, adapter throws "upstream certificate signature expired" | **`403 INVALID_TOKEN`** (a real fault misread as a refusal) | `500 INTERNAL` |

The card's premise holds in part. Malformed tokens, and wrong-verb tokens (a case the card did not list), answered 5xx. Forged and expired tokens already answered 4xx, but each message named the check that failed.

## Status: 401, not the 403 the old branch used

The dispatch suggested reusing "the code and status the storage family's other token refusals use". Measured, the family's code is `INVALID_TOKEN`, but its status is split two ways:

- **Declared: 401.**
  - `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx` publishes `INVALID_TOKEN` as **HTTP 401**, "emitted only by the storage routes, on a rejected upload/download token". Its example message is `Invalid or expired token`, and it states "no `details.reason`: the emitting site deliberately does not disclose why the token failed".
  - `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx` lists the code under `## Authentication Errors (401)`.
  - `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts` groups it under `// Authentication Errors (401)`.
- **Emitted: 403.** The old handler branch emitted 403, through a ternary the error-status gate cannot read. That is why `INVALID_TOKEN` sat in `scripts/error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`: documented, but pinned by nothing. The sibling `INVALID_RESUME_TOKEN` is also 403, but it is a different, ledger-registered code.

Following the house order (spec declaration over implementation over docs), this PR emits the declared 401. The published entry was already right on all three points (status, message, non-disclosure); before this change the runtime matched none of them. Known callers do not branch on the status: the SDK's `storage.upload` PUTs through raw `fetchImpl`, and the console's `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` checks only `res.ok`. The other reading, 403 everywhere, would have meant rewriting the published `INVALID_TOKEN` entry against the spec grouping. That choice is raised in the dev report for the PM to confirm or overturn. Switching would mean changing the one literal in `sendRawByteRouteFailure`, the test pins, and the `error-handling.mdx` entry.

Since the status is now a literal, `check:error-status-conformance` reads it, finds it matches both pages, and pins `INVALID_TOKEN`. The gate then requires its unpinned-baseline row to ratchet down. That one-row deletion (`--update`, which the gate's self-test marks as the author's own remedy) is the only file outside the claimed surface.

## Pins

- `storage-routes.raw-token-refusal.test.ts` (new, 28 cases):
  - Five refusal cases × {PUT, GET} × {bare adapter, swappable wrapper}. Each asserts `401`, `success: false`, `error.code === 'INVALID_TOKEN'`, the shared message, and that the adapter's `upload`/`download` were never called.
  - One identical-message check per route per composition.
  - A valid-token adapter fault on each route answers `500 INTERNAL`, including the fault whose text reads "signature expired".
- `local-storage-adapter.test.ts`: the old `toThrow('expired')` / `toThrow('mismatch')` assertions named texts that no longer exist. They now assert the branded refusal. Two new tests show that all four card cases throw one indistinguishable refusal, and that a plain `Error` carrying the same text is not recognised.
- Two existing pins move 403 → 401: `storage-routes.test.ts` ("should reject invalid token on raw upload", which now also asserts the code) and `error-envelope.conformance.test.ts` ("raw download with a forged token signature").

## Ablations

Both ran on committed HEAD `3f3bacfe9c` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrapped in a script with an absolute-path `git checkout HEAD --` trap. Restoration was proven by the blob hash matching HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import the subject from `src`, so no rebuild was involved.

**A: `verifyToken` throws a plain `Error` again.**
- Mutation: anchor `throw new StorageTokenRefusedError();` changed 5 → 0, plain-`Error` throws 0 → 5, blob `e48a34f195d8` → `414cea511662`.
- Result: `src/storage-routes.raw-token-refusal.test.ts (28 tests | 24 failed)` with `AssertionError: expected 500 to be 401`. The message checks failed with `expected [ 'Invalid storage token format' ] to deeply equal [ 'Invalid or expired token' ]`. The adapter file had 3 of 18 failing.
- The 4 route cases still passing are exactly the forced-fault pins, which held at 500.
- Restored: blob `e48a34f195d8` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**B: the handler reads the message again.**
- Mutation: brand check changed 1 → 0, `err?.message?.includes('expired')` 0 → 1.
- Result: `(28 tests | 2 failed)`, exactly the two "upstream certificate signature expired" fault pins, with `AssertionError: expected 401 to be 500`.
- Restored: blob `aa8c59d3602d` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification

All readings below are at HEAD `3f3bacfe9c`, merge base `02bec6ca86`.

- **Package tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` passed, with 52 files and 876 tests.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage typecheck` exited 0. That covers src, `tsconfig.scripts.json`, and the test layer under `tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc --listFiles` on the test layer counts 52 `*.test.ts`, including all four test files this PR touches.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 76 commands from this tree. The PM's reading had 68; the 8 extra come from touching `scripts/error-status-unpinned-baseline.json`. Reconciled with `--ran`, every command's exit code recorded, the result is "76 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
  - `check:error-status-conformance` passed: "every derivable runtime status is documented, and every documented status is reachable."
  - `check:i18n` passed: "OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)".
  - `check:type-check-debt` passed: "OK — 1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number". Its first attempt exited 3 because the re-measure's build was OOM-killed on the shared box. The damaged `dist/` trees were rebuilt (turbo, 60/60 tasks) and the gate was re-run.
  - **NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET**, because it needs every package's `dist/` (a whole-repo build). Narrowed equivalent: `service-storage` built at HEAD (the brand string is in `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.js`), and `require('./dist/index.cjs')` loads, with `LocalStorageAdapter` and `registerStorageRoutes` both functions. CI runs the full gate.
- **Lint (narrowed, not the repo-wide `pnpm lint`):** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 6 changed TS files reported 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and no ignore notices, so all six are inside the linted population. `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its own comment near line 327), so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.
- **Not run locally:** integration tiers and the whole-repo scans belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not changed here)

- **The swappable wrapper turns a capability absence into a 500.** `SwappableStorageService.verifyToken` throws a plain `Error` ("Active storage adapter does not support verifyToken()") when the active adapter has no `verifyToken`. Because the plugin always mounts the wrapper, the handlers' `if (!localAdapter.verifyToken)` 501 branch is never reached in a booted deployment. Measured at route level: over an `S3StorageAdapter` the wrapper answers `500 INTERNAL` on both byte routes, where the bare S3 adapter answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`. Not measured on a booted S3 deployment.
- **A 500 on these routes passes the raw error text through** (the storage family's 5xx arms generally do, against the platform rule that a 5xx withholds its message text). This PR's patch round withholds it on the two raw-byte routes; the family card is #23174. Evidence and reproduction are held off public surfaces (lane disclosure rule; redacted in place by the `domain:services` seat 2 PM).
- **The HMAC comparison is not constant-time.** `verifyToken` compares the signature with `!==`, while the repo's other signature and password checks (`packages/core/src/security/http-signature.ts`, `plugin-sharing`'s `share-link-password.ts`, `trigger-api`'s `api-trigger.ts`) use `timingSafeEqual`. This PR changes only what that line throws, not the comparison.

## Patch round (head `7f0eeb5619`, after merging `origin/main` `e540e7ffb9`)

- **A 5xx on the raw byte routes withholds its message text, per the platform rule.** `sendRawByteRouteFailure`'s 500 arm now answers `500 INTERNAL` with the route's generic text (`Upload failed` / `Download failed`). The original error, with its stack, is logged first through `logServerFault` (`@objectstack/types`), the same server-fault funnel `sendError` writes every 5xx line to. That line is keyed by the mounted route pattern, not the request URL, because the URL carries a live signed token. The family's other 5xx arms in `storage-routes.ts` are untouched.
- **Token signatures are compared in constant time.** `verifyToken` uses `timingSafeEqual`. A signature of a different length is refused first with the same `StorageTokenRefusedError`, as core's `http-signature.ts` does. This supersedes the third Acceptance note above.
- **Pins.** On both routes, an adapter fault whose message carries a path-like string answers `500 INTERNAL` with `success: false`; the body contains none of that string, and the server-fault log line does. A same-length forged signature and two wrong-length signatures each throw `StorageTokenRefusedError`.
- **Ablation C** (the 500 arm passes `err?.message` again): anchor 1 to 0, blob `391d77717a28` to `3d3aa17943a1`. Result `(30 tests | 2 failed)`, exactly the two withholding pins: `AssertionError: expected '{"success":false,"error":{"code":"INT…' not to contain` the fixture's path-like string. Restored: blob == HEAD `391d77717a28`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation D** (the length guard removed): `(19 tests | 1 failed)`, the wrong-length pin: `expected RangeError: Input buffers must have the s… to be an instance of StorageTokenRefusedError`. Restored: blob == HEAD `4b371f4dca6a`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Verification at `7f0eeb5619`.** Package suite 52 files / 879 tests passed. Typecheck exit 0, test layer included. `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 76; `--ran` gives "76 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (whole-repo build). Narrowed equivalent: `service-storage` built at HEAD and `require('./dist/index.cjs')` loads. Narrowed eslint on the 6 changed TS files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
